g.text: exact(), glob(), regex(), anyOf(), any(), fromSpec()
An event or topic selector crosses to the broker
as JSON and routes there; every predicate and
operator runs worker-side. A string is exact or
a glob; a regex is only built on request.
A stream rather than a bare callback, so the
operator layer landed without changing a single
existing call site. Each operator is a decorator;
Every operator that keeps the element type hands
back a StateChangeStream, so whenChangedTo() still
chains after a filter(). Only map() drops out.
Injected beside HaContext, not hung off it: operators
compose over an event source, and a schedule has none.
Occurrences resolve in Home Assistant's timezone.
